notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company (B2B SaaS) — ran Hosted API trial in Oct. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and cost. Primary drivers: improve interactive chat latency, reduce per-token cost at scale, and get VPC isolation for customer data.

POC / Timeline (shorthand):
- 2025-09-30: Intro demo (Aisha) — product team liked streaming + tool-calling examples.
- 2025-10-03 -> 2025-10-24: Hosted API trial (self-serve + AE support).
- 2025-10-15: Perf test w/ synthetic traffic (Miguel ran load script).
- 2025-10-22: Weekly sync, security questionnaire provided; Fireflies ff_2025-10-22_7931.
- 2025-10-28: Deep-dive on routing/fallbacks + cost model (ff_2025-10-28_8014).
- 2025-11-01: Internal procurement checklist kicked off; legal asked for SOC2/ISO proof.

Hosted trial observed metrics (real numbers from POC):
- Duration: ~3 weeks, ~120k total requests.
- Mix: chat 62%, embeddings 18%, reranking 20%.
- Avg QPS (sustained off-peak): 6-9 QPS.
- Peak QPS observed during weekday morning surge: 34 QPS (10:30-10:40 window).
- Concurrency (simulated spike): up to 18 concurrent in trial; product expects concurrency to grow with adoption to 35-45.
- Token mix (avg/request): prompt ~420 tokens, completion ~140 tokens -> ~560 tokens/request.
- Median request size skew: support chat prompts longer (avg 700 tokens) vs reranking calls short (<60 tokens).
- P95 generation latency on Hosted: 220-280ms (too high for their interactive UX target).

Customer targets / requirements:
- Latency SLO: p95 generation latency <= 120ms (interactive chat), 50ms for reranking.
- Throughput target: steady-state 30 QPS for core app, burst capability to 150 QPS for Black Friday-style spikes.
- Concurrency planning: target comfortable concurrency 40 per region.
- Token throughput planning: anticipate growth to ~15M tokens/day in 12 months if adoption accelerates.
- Model preferences: prefer top open models with FP16/INT8 options; willingness to trade small quality loss for 30-40% cost savings via quantization.
- Routing/fallback: need policy to route to cheaper model variant under capacity pressure and immediate fallback to hosted replica if Dedicated outage.
- Data residency: EU customers require data residency; want multi-region (NA + EU) Dedicated pools or Private option later.

Cost sensitivity and ARR assumptions:
- Willing to commit to annual reserved capacity if unit costs hit target.
- Rough ARR they can justify today: $60k-200k depending on committed QPS and pricing.

Requested deliverables from Redwood (next 2 weeks):
- Dedicated sizing recommendation: suggested GPU pool sizing (baseline + burst headroom) with example mapping to expected QPS/concurrency and token/sec.
- Cost model: per-token and per-hour cost comparisons Hosted vs Dedicated (with quantization scenarios).
- Performance plan: expected p95 token latency estimates per model variant and concurrency envelope.
- Security artifacts: SOC2 report, encryption-at-rest details, KMS integration notes.

Quotes / call notes (verbatim/fragments):
- "We loved the ease of Hosted — but p95 latency killed the demo to execs." — Head of Product.
- "If you can show predictable costs and a sizing plan that gets us under $/seat targets, we can commit." — CFO (pricing call 2025-10-28).

Open questions & blockers (CRM-style):
- Legal: require SOC2 + statement on third-party key storage (blocker).
- Infra: need clearer mapping from GPU SKU + #instances -> sustainable QPS for their token mix (blocker).
- Budget: final dollar cap TBD by execs; pricing proposal will drive procurement cadence.

Next steps (short):
- Miguel to deliver Dedicated sizing proposal + spreadsheets (by 2025-11-05).
- Aisha to set up CFO pricing review (calendar invite pending).
- Legal will review SOC2 artifacts once shared.

Linked artifacts: pricing deck (drive/mossbridge/pricing/dedicated-sizing-v2.pdf), security FAQ (drive/mossbridge/security/security-faq.pdf), Fireflies meeting ids above, Jira INF-4721 for infra sizing question.

Internal AE notes: prioritize a 2-scenario sizing sheet: (1) conservative reserve (30 QPS steady, 80 QPS burst) and (2) aggressive reserve (60 QPS steady, 150 QPS burst) with cost per token under FP16 vs INT8 quant. Keep proposal modular — they may start with Dedicated in NA only then add EU region later.
